# env/components-creds.example.txt — infra-creds template for 16-recommendation (### NN_Service format).
#
# REAL secrets go in env/components-creds.txt (GITIGNORED) — never in this committed
# .example file. Workflow:
#   cp env/components-creds.example.txt env/components-creds.txt
#   $EDITOR env/components-creds.txt        # paste your REAL infra creds (the full ### dump)
#   chmod 600 env/components-creds.txt
#   ./env/init-env.sh .env.dev             # renders env/.env.dev
#
# init-env.sh reads env/components-creds.txt (gitignored). Paste your FULL infra status
# dump (all ### blocks); 16-recommendation uses only these:
#   01_PostgreSQL 02_MongoDB 04_Redis 05_Kafka 07_Elastic_APM 12_Qdrant.
# The application LOG-SINK Elasticsearch is the APM-stack ES (block 07 → :9200,
# user 'elastic', elastic-pass) — NOT block 03_Elasticsearch (:9201), which is the
# search/review business ES used ONLY by 05-search + 08-review (so it is not listed here).
#
# 16-recommendation is VERIFY-ONLY: it does NOT mint JWTs. Paste 01-auth's public key +
# the shared INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN into the ### Auth_Identity block below (from 01-auth's
# rendered env/.env.dev). If left as placeholders, init-env.sh falls back to AUTH_ENV_FILE
# (default /opt/01-auth/env/.env.dev) auto-discovery.

### 01_PostgreSQL
   host:port      <host>:5432
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 02_MongoDB
   endpoint       mongodb://<user>:<password>@<host>:27017/?authSource=admin

### 04_Redis
   host:port      <host>:6379
   password       <password>

### 05_Kafka
   bootstrap      <host>:9092

### 07_Elastic_APM
   elasticsearch  http://elastic:<elastic-pass>@<host>:9200
   apm-ingest     http://<host>:8200  (Bearer token)
   apm-token      <apm-token>
   elastic-pass   <elastic-pass>

### 12_Qdrant
   rest           http://<host>:6333
   api-key        <key>

### Auth_Identity
   auth_service_public_key   <paste 01-auth .env.dev JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64>
   internal_service_token    <paste 01-auth .env.dev INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN>
